title: LIGHTBEAM-U01 Substudy 01E: A Phase 2 Substudy to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Belzutifan in Participants With Solid Tumors
official: LIGHTBEAM-U01 Substudy 01E: A Phase 2 Substudy to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Belzutifan in Participants With Solid Tumors
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety of belzutifan
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has a diagnosis of one of the following: locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma or wild-type gastrointestinal stromal tumors, or localized tumors associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease
2. Has measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors 1.1
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has a pulse oximeter reading <92% at rest, requires intermittent supplemental oxygen, or requires chronic supplemental oxygen
2. Has clinically significant cardiac disease or electrocardiogram indicating uncontrolled cardiac condition or has congenital long QT syndrome
3. Has a history of human immunodeficiency virus infection
4. Has received prior treatment with any hypoxia inducible factor-2α inhibitor, including belzutifan
5. Has had an allogenic tissue/solid organ transplant
6. Has a history of autologous stem cell transplant within 6 months of start of study intervention
7. Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years
8. Has known active central nervous system metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
9. Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy
